No action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless certain emergency or special circumstances
exist. The legislative body or its staff may: 1) Briefly respond to statements made or questions asked by persons; or 2) Direct
staff to investigate and/or schedule matters for consideration at a future meeting. [Government Code §54954.2]

  ESTE ES EL PERIODO DESIGNADO PARA DIRIGIRSE AL CONCILIO

No se podra tomar acción en algún asunto a menos que sea incluido en la agenda, o a menos que exista algúna emergencia
o circunstancia especial. El cuerpo legislativo y su personal podran: 1) Responder brevemente a declaraciónes o preguntas
hechas por personas; o 2) Dirigir personal a investigar y/o fijar asuntos para tomar en consideración en juntas proximas.
[Codigo de Gobierno §54954.2]

CONSENT CALENDAR
All items listed are considered to be routine business by the City Council and will be approved with one motion. There will be no separate
discussion of these items unless a City Councilmember so requests, in which case, the item will be removed from the general order of
business and considered in its normal sequence on the agenda.

1.  WARRANTS AND DEMANDS
  Staff recommends City Council receive and file.

2.  PROPOSED RECOGNITIONS BY THE MAYOR AND CITY COUNCIL FOR THE
  PERIOD OF JULY 21, 2010 - AUGUST 4, 2010
  Staff recommends City Council approve the preparation and presentation of the
  plaques, proclamations and certificates as outlined in the staff report.

3.  MINUTES
  Staff recommends City Council approve the minutes of the May 5, 2010 regular meeting
  and the June 2, 2010 regular meeting.
City Council Agenda – July 21, 2010  Page 2
 4.  CLAIM REJECTIONS
  Staff recommends City Council reject the claims of Mariesco Sarie, Timothy Valdez,
  Veronica Larios and Maria Blanco and direct staff to send the appropriate notice of
  rejection to claimants.

5.  CITY TREASURER’S REPORT – MAY & JUNE 2010
  Staff recommends City Council receive and file.

6.  RESOLUTION NO. 2010-023 APPROVING A LOT TIE OF TWO PARCELS
  RESULTING IN ONE LEGAL LOT
  Staff recommends City Council waive further reading, read by title only and adopt
  Resolution No. 2010-023 entitled, "A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF BALDWIN PARK, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING THE RECORDATION OF A
  COVENANT AND AGREEMENT TO HOLD PARCEL 8551-007-033 AND PARCEL
  8551-007-034 AS ONE PARCEL."

7.  RESOLUTION NO. 2010-031 AUTHORIZING THE FILING OF AN APPLICATION
  FOR USED OIL RECYCLING BLOCK GRANT FUNDS
  Staff recommends City Council waive further reading, read by title only and adopt
  Resolution No. 2010-031 entitled, "A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF BALDWIN PARK, CALIFORNIA AUTHORIZING THE DIRECTOR OF PUBLIC
  WORKS TO FILE AN APPLICATION AND SERVE AS SIGNATORY AUTHORITY FOR
  THE USED OIL BLOCK GRANT FUNDS."

8.  ACCEPTANCE OF THE CDBG / ARRA STREET IMPROVEMENTS PROJECT
  CONSTRUCTED BY KORMX, INC. AND AUTHORIZATION TO RECORD THE
  NOTICE OF COMPLETION
  Staff recommends City Council 1) accept the construction improvements by Kormx, Inc.
  and authorize the recordation of a Notice of Completion; 2) authorize a contract extra in
  the amount of $6,800 to GK and Associates; and 3) authorize the payment of $30,406 in
  retention funds to Kormx, Inc. upon expiration of the 35-day lien period.

9.  RESOLUTION NO. 2010-034 DECLARING THE CITY COUNCIL'S INTENT TO
  VACATE A PORTION OF MONTEREY AVENUE AND ACCEPT AN IRREVOCABLE
  OFFER OF DEDICATION IN ITS PLACE
  Staff recommends City Council waive further reading, read by title only and adopt
  Resolution No. 2010-034 entitled, "A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF BALDWIN PARK, CALIFORNIA, DECLARING ITS INTENTION TO VACATE
  A PORTION OF STREET RIGHT-OF-WAY ON MONTEREY AVENUE, V-1-2010."

10.  APPROVE THE PLANS, SPECIFICATIONS AND ENGINEER’S ESTIMATE FOR THE
  PROP 1B – PHASE I – CITYWIDE STREET IMPROVEMENTS AND INSTALLATION
  OF SPEED HUMPS PROJECT AND AUTHORIZE ITS ADVERTISING FOR
  CONSTRUCTION BIDS
  Staff recommends City Council approve the design (Plans, Specifications, and
  Engineer’s Estimate – PS & E) for the Prop 1B Citywide Street Improvements Project –
  Phase I and authorize staff to advertise the project for construction bids.

City Council Agenda – July 21, 2010  Page 3
 11.  NEIGHBORHOOD STABILIZATION PROGRAM (NSP) - PURCHASE OF
  PROPERTIES ELIGIBLE UNDER THE NSP
  Staff recommends City Council ratify the purchase of properties eligible under the NSP
  located at 4009 Puente Avenue and 15113 Badillo Street, Baldwin Park, California
  91706.

SET MATTERS - PUBLIC HEARINGS (7:00 P.M. or as soon thereafter as the matter can be heard). If in the future you
wish to challenge the following in court, you may be limited to raising only those issues you or someone else raised at the public hearing
described in this notice or in written correspondence delivered to the City Clerk and/or City Council at or prior to the public hearing.

12.  PUBLIC HEARING TO REQUEST TO RECORD A SPECIAL ASSESSMENT WITH
  THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY AUDITOR-CONTROLLER FOR AN OUTSTANDING
  CODE ENFORCEMENT ABATEMENT COST AT THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT
  14928 DEXTER STREET
  Staff recommends City Council conduct the public hearing and following the public
  hearing approve recording against the subject property, by the Los Angeles County
  Auditor-Controller, Tax Division, a special assessment for the City's outstanding costs in
  the amount of $3,854.45, related to the abatement of a public nuisance and recording a
  release of the existing lien against the subject property for those abatement costs.

13.  PUBLIC HEARING AND ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. 2010-032, ORDERING
  THE ASSESSMENTS FOR THE CITYWIDE LANDSCAPING AND LIGHTING
  MAINTENANCE ASSESSMENT DISTRICT FOR FY 2010-2011
  Staff recommends City Council conduct the public hearing and after considering
  testimony, waive further reading, read by title only and adopt Resolution No. 2010-032
  entitled, "A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN
  PARK, CALIFORNIA, ORDERING THE ANNUAL LEVY AND COLLECTION OF
  ASSESSMENTS ASSOCIATED WITH THE CITYWIDE LANDSCAPING AND
  LIGHTING MAINTENANCE ASSESSMENT DISTRICT FOR FY 2010-2011, AND
  AUTHORIZING THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY ASSESSOR TO ADD THIS SPECIAL
  ASSESSMENT TO THE PROPERTY TAX BILLS."

14.  PUBLIC HEARING AND ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. 2010-033, ORDERING
  THE ASSESSMENTS FOR THE CITYWIDE PARK MAINTENANCE ASSESSMENT
  DISTRICT FOR FY 2010-2011
  Staff recommends City Council conduct a public hearing, and after considering
  testimony, waive further reading, read by title only and adopt Resolution No. 2010-033
  entitled, "A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN
  PARK, CALIFORNIA, ORDERING THE ANNUAL LEVY AND COLLECTION OF
  ASSESSMENTS ASSOCIATED WITH THE CITYWIDE PARK MAINTENANCE
  ASSESSMENT DISTRICT FOR FY 2010-2011, AND AUTHORIZING THE LOS
  ANGELES COUNTY ASSESSOR TO ADD THIS SPECIAL ASSESSMENT TO THE
  PROPERTY TAX BILLS."

15.  PUBLIC HEARING TO INTRODUCE FOR FIRST READING ORDINANCE NO. 1335
  Staff recommends City Council conduct a public hearing and following the public
  hearing, waive further reading, read by title only and introduce for first reading
  Ordinance No. 1335 entitled, "AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF BALDWIN PARK AMENDING CHAPTER 73 OF THE BALDWIN PARK
  MUNICIPAL CODE RELATING TO SPEED LIMITS ON CERTAIN STREETS.”

City Council Agenda – July 21, 2010  Page 4
 REPORTS OF OFFICERS

16.  REQUEST FOR CITY COUNCIL DIRECTION ON BUS WRAP PREFERENCES FOR
  NEW CNG TRANSIT BUSES

  Staff recommends City Council selection one of the following options or provide
  direction to staff on a different option: 1) direct staff to apply the current wrap design of
  “Diversity of our Strength” with the appropriate color and design at a cost of about
  $18,000 for all the new buses ($6,000 for the large and $3,000 for the small buses) or
  2) authorize staff to develop and provide a sample of new design options for City
  Council to select from and wrap the new buses and the existing buses with the new
  colors and theme at an approximate cost of $30,000.

17.  REVIEW OF COMMISSION APPLICANTS AND CONSIDERATION OF
  APPOINTMENTS AND/OR REAPPOINTMENTS TO FILL THE JUNE 30, 2010
  SCHEDULED VACANCIES (Continued from June 16, 2010)
  Staff recommends City Council review all Commission applications and:

  1)  Take nominations and adopt Resolution No. 2010-025 entitled, "A
  RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK,
  AMENDING RESOLUTION NO. 2009-039 APPOINTING AN INDIVIDUAL TO THE
  HOUSING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK, SPECIFICALLY
  ___________TO OFFICE NO. 1 FOR A TERM EXPIRING JUNE 30, 2011"

  2) Take nominations and adopt Resolution No. 2010-026 entitled, "A RESOLUTION
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK, AMENDING
  RESOLUTION NO. 2008-029 APPOINTING INDIVIDUALS TO THE PERSONNEL
  COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK, SPECIFICALLY: -
  _______________ TO OFFICE NO. 1 FOR A TERM TO JUNE 30, 2012; AND -
  ________________TO OFFICE NO. 2 FOR A TERM TO JUNE 30, 2012" and direct
  staff to re-notice the un-filled vacancies and bring back to a future meeting for
  appointment; and

  3) Take nominations and adopt Resolution No. 2010-027 entitled, "A RESOLUTION
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK, AMENDING
  RESOLUTION NO. 2010-007 APPOINTING INDIVIDUALS TO THE PLANNING
  COMMISSION  OF  THE  CITY  OF BALDWIN PARK, SPECIFICALLY:
  _____________TO OFFICE NO. 3 FOR A TERM TO EXPIRE JUNE 30, 2012;
  _____________ TO OFFICE NO. 4 FOR A TERM TO EXPIRE JUNE 30, 2012; AND
  _____________ TO OFFICE NO. 5 FOR A TERM TO EXPIRE JUNE 30, 2012" and

  4) Take nominations and adopt Resolution No. 2010-028 entitled, "A RESOLUTION
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK, AMENDING
  RESOLUTION NO. 2009-040 APPOINTING INDIVIDUALS TO THE RECREATION &
  COMMUNITY SERVICES COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK,
  SPECIFICALLY: ________________TO OFFICE NO. 1 FOR A TERM EXPIRING
  JUNE 30, 2012; ___________________TO OFFICE NO. 2 FOR A TERM EXPIRING
  JUNE 30, 2012; ___________ TO OFFICE NO. 3 FOR A TERM EXPIRING JUNE 30,
  2012; AND __________________TO OFFICE NO. 6 (SVHS) FOR A TERM TO JUNE
  30, 2011" and defer appointment to Office Nos. 7 & 8 (BPHS & NPHS respectively) until
  such time as a nomination is received from the school.

  Request for Council discussion and direction to staff to bring forward a resolution in
